svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Lattice Join
svg.desc: Policy layers fold in a fixed order through the lattice join; repository control overrides apply after the join.

g.text: common-utils:2 twice, same ref: kept once
same identity, other tag or options: error
newEffectivePolicy seeds the result with DefaultPolicy.
pinnedLayer rejects a file whose digest differs from its lock pin (ErrLockDigestMismatch) or whose id changed.
native-gpu-systems then contributes its complexity caps and controls.
security:high adds two required reviewers, SLSA level 3 and two linters.
Selected fleet, organization, deployment and workstation files fold in, in that order.
The manifest's overrides.complexity joins as one more layer.
When Audit is set, as in audit and adopt, the audit-compat ceiling folds in last.
Join keeps the lowest positive complexity cap, the higher reviewer count and SLSA level, true over false, strict_ban over
ArchetypeControls.validate rejects review_mode on every layer, so the joined policy keeps the independent default.
finishEffectivePolicy applies only branch_protection and supply_chain through ApplyOverrides; review_mode may relax to
standardsctl audit, adopt plans, devcontainer and workstation install each resolve policy through this loader.
ResolveDevContainerFeatures re-reads the pinned files: one feature identity with another tag, digest or options fails closed.
